name: Fate's Hand — Spells (EN)

attribution.text: Original Fate's Hand content: all rights reserved. This layer adds three spells of its own and modifies NO material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1: it rewrites no SRD text and disables no SRD record. It patches two SRD spells with an FH-ONLY field, `data[fh_effect]`, which does not exist in the SRD — the SRD spell stands exactly as printed and the Fate's Hand effect is added beside it.

description: The spells of the chapter `Fate's Hand Spells` that are NOT Soulforging. Three are new — Appease the Chaos, Devil-Vision, Consecration. Two are SRD spells that Fate's Hand adds an effect to, without touching a word of them: Bless, Guidance. ⚠️ Lot 179 — the chapter has eight spells; the three that serve Soulforge Crafting (Transfer Essence, Identify, Gentle Repose) moved to `fh-soulforging-en` so that chapter can be switched off on its own. Read the two layers together to see the eight.

data.description:
You spend a Destiny Point to appease the wrath of the forces of chaos on the targeted creature, within 1 round following a Chaos Effect. You reduce the potency of the effect by a number equal to your proficiency bonus.

Example. Bruggar rolled 10 on the Strength Chaos table; Awki has a proficiency bonus of 3. The roll is reduced to 7.
data.name: Appease the Chaos

data.description: The target can see through magical and normal darkness out to 60 feet. No upcasting.
data.name: Devil-Vision

data.components: V, S, M (an agate worth 100 GP)
data.description:
You consecrate the place. Within the radius: one creature regains 1 Destiny Point at the end of its next Long Rest; Dispel Magic is applied against any spell in the area cast by a Fiend or an Undead; Lesser Restoration is applied to one creature.

Spending Destiny Points. For each additional Destiny Point spent, choose one, and it applies within the same radius: extend one of the effects above to several creatures; a further Lesser Restoration; a further Dispel Magic against a spell cast by a Fiend or an Undead.

The agate is not consumed unless a Destiny Point is spent.
data.name: Consecration

changes.data[fh_effect]: If the caster spends one Destiny Point, the cost of fate is reduced by one for the creatures affected by the spell, for its duration. Except on critical rolls.

srd:spell:en:bless.note: Fate's Hand adds an effect to Bless and changes nothing else: the SRD spell stands as printed.

changes.data[fh_effect]: Either the usual effect, or: you touch one willing creature and grant it 1 temporary Destiny Point for the duration of the spell. A single creature can only benefit from this effect once per long rest.

srd:spell:en:guidance.note: Fate's Hand offers an alternative effect on Guidance; the SRD effect remains available and unchanged.
